name: Jim Root
intro: Technology by day, a small homestead after hours, and a camera on every trip. Here's what I've been seeing.
about: I’ve built a career in technology, and I bring the same curiosity home to a small homestead in north-central Pennsylvania. Days are spent on systems and strategy; evenings and weekends are for the flock, the trail, and wherever the road leads. Winston is almost always riding shotgun, and a camera is never far away, whether it’s a sunrise over the fields at home or a coastline a few states away. I’ve never been one to stay put for long, and some of my favorite days are the ones without much of a plan. This site is where I share the places I explore, life at home, and the occasional project I’m tinkering with.
contact_text: Technology, homestead life or a trail recommendation. Messages go straight to my inbox.
subscribe_text: A short note when I've posted something new. No spam, unsubscribe anytime.

crew.name: Winston
crew.title: Flock Supervisor
crew.bio: A yellow Lab who's all smiles and has never met a stranger. Winston loves everyone, keeps an eye on the flock, and claims the passenger seat on just about every road trip. From muddy trails to city sidewalks, he treats every new stop like it was planned just for him, and he shows up in more of these photos than I do. For reasons nobody can explain, he has a thing for bright colors, and his most prized possession is whichever pink pig toy he hasn't chewed to pieces yet.
